brief.primary_task: Find and click their local city / region Craigslist site in 3 seconds

must_keep.why: Purple wordmark is the only brand signal, must be preserved for trust
Interactive world map with site pins is the primary visual wayfinding device

must_keep.ref: US Canada Europe Asia/Pacific/Middle East Oceania Latin America Africa
must_keep.why: Top anchor nav enables 3-second jump to region, core utility
H1 defines page purpose as global directory index
US state -> city link directory holds most link equity and traffic
Complete Canada city directory must remain crawlable and clickable
Complete Europe city directory must remain crawlable and clickable
Complete Asia/Pacific/Middle East directory must remain crawlable
Complete Oceania directory must remain crawlable
Complete Latin America directory must remain crawlable
Complete Africa directory must remain crawlable

missing_imagery.what: Instant search / filter input with autocomplete for city
missing_imagery.why: 700+ links unscanable without type-to-filter, top agency would add for 3s task
Removes manual scanning of map and long lists on mobile
